name: tlf-planning
title: TLF planning from USDM
description: Plan the exhaustive, traceable list of Tables, Listings and Figures a study needs from its USDM study definition (plus SAP, protocol and shells as context, and the delivered SDTM domains for feasibility). The AI planner interprets objectives and endpoints, adds the ICH E3 scaffolding, expands analysis variants and numbers the outputs; a deterministic gate checks the schema, every trace, the numbering and that every resolved endpoint is accounted for (failures go back to the AI, three attempts); an independent AI critic audits completeness; the statistician approves or sends the plan back with a comment. Runs standalone (upload) or inside a parent workflow (study package in the trigger).
preamble: CDISC and ICH terms (USDM, SDTM, ADaM, ICH E3 section 14, estimands, endpoints, LOCF, MMRM, ANCOVA, adverse events, deaths) are technical workflow content.

triggerInput.name: package
triggerInput.description: Study package from a parent workflow: { study, profile, files: [{ name, downloadUrl, kind, sha256 }] } with kind usdm, optionally sap, protocol, shells, and sdtm (only the domain names are used). Leave empty to upload by hand.

steps.name: Resolve inputs
steps.description: Deterministic. Picks the USDM and context documents from the study package, or routes to the upload step.

steps.name: Upload USDM and context
steps.description: Upload the USDM study-definition JSON. Optionally the SAP and protocol (PDF/text; a file name containing 'sap' is read as the SAP), sponsor table shells ('shell' in the name), and the SDTM datasets (.xpt, used only for their domain names to check feasibility).

steps.name: Stage inputs
steps.description: Deterministic. sha256-verifies the inputs and stages them under /workspace/tlf-planning/inputs (usdm.json, sap/, protocol/, shells/, sdtm-domains.json).

steps.name: Plan TLFs
steps.description: AI. Runs the tlf-planner skill: study model from the USDM, ICH E3 scaffolding, efficacy/safety/special-domain candidates, analysis variants, feasibility against the delivered SDTM, numbering. Writes study-model.json, tlf-plan.json and tlf-index.md. On a gate retry it fixes the listed problems; on a review round it changes only what the reviewer asked.

agent.prompt: You are the study statistician planning the TLF package for this run. Read /artifacts/skills/tlf-planner/SKILL.md now and follow it exactly; its references are in /artifacts/skills/tlf-planner/references/. Inputs are under /workspace/tlf-planning/inputs/ (read-only); write the plan to /workspace/tlf-planning/plan/. If /workspace/tlf-planning/feedback.json exists, the deterministic gate rejected your last plan: fix exactly the problems it lists. If /workspace/tlf-planning/review-feedback.jsonl exists, its LAST line is the statistician's change request: change only what it asks and keep the candidate_id and final_id of every untouched output stable. Finish only when `python3 /artifacts/scripts/self_check.py` prints PASS, then write /output/result.json as the skill describes.

steps.name: Check the plan
steps.description: Deterministic gate: both files parse, every candidate follows the schema, every trace resolves into the study model, final_ids are unique and match the type, flagged outputs carry a reason and stay unnumbered, every resolved endpoint is traced by a candidate, and the index lists every planned output. Failures go back to the planner (three attempts per review round). On pass publishes the plan and tlf-plan.html.

steps.name: Audit the plan
steps.description: AI, independent of the planner (fresh context, reads only the plan and the study model). Runs the tlf-plan-critic skill: forward and backward coverage, completeness heuristics (deaths table, sensitivity analyses, by-site, Hy's Law...), clarification items, and a verdict. Writes coverage-report.md. Read-only: it never edits the plan.

agent.prompt: You are an independent reviewer auditing a TLF plan you did not write. Read /artifacts/skills/tlf-plan-critic/SKILL.md now and follow it exactly; its checklist is in /artifacts/skills/tlf-plan-critic/references/ and the shared schemas in /artifacts/skills/tlf-planner/references/. Read only /workspace/tlf-planning/plan/tlf-plan.json, /workspace/tlf-planning/plan/study-model.json and /workspace/tlf-planning/plan-check.json. Do not edit the plan. Write /workspace/tlf-planning/audit/coverage-report.md (also copy it to /output/coverage-report.md) and /output/result.json as the skill describes.

steps.name: Review the TLF plan
steps.description: Review the planned outputs (tlf-plan.html from Check the plan: every output with its analysis and what it traces to, plus the flagged items) and the critic's coverage report. Approve to publish the plan, or request changes with a comment; the planner changes only what you ask.

params.name: comment
params.description: What to change about the TLF plan (required when requesting changes).

steps.name: Record the change request
steps.description: Deterministic. Appends the reviewer's comment to review-feedback.jsonl for the planner (and later skill learning) and resets the gate's attempts.

steps.name: Return result
steps.description: Deterministic. outcome = planned (publishes study-model, tlf-plan json/md/html, coverage-report, review feedback into the study package) or failed (the gate still fails after the last attempt; the planner's files are attached, the package's plan is unchanged).
